name: Bento Grid
tagline: Light-gray canvas with rounded white modular cards, one electric-blue hero tile, mono labels and tiny sparklines (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Apple-style light gray ground, white cards, single blue accent

typography.style: Heavy tight-tracked Inter numerals with Geist Mono uppercase labels

best_for: Metric-rich summaries where many small facts must be seen at once, such as annual reports and product dashboards. Works for any audience that likes a calm, Apple-like look.
avoid_for: Long narrative or emotional storytelling where a single image or sentence should dominate.
